weekly_objective: Absorb the extra MTB load from Monday and Wednesday, keep the weekend easy and aerobic, and protect one heavy strength stimulus before next Tuesday's committed double.
coach_says: The two extra MTB rides on Monday and Wednesday took the place of your swim and yoga. With readiness at 12 this morning, today's Thursday session should default to its fallback: 50 min Z2 and core-only gym. I've swapped Friday's ride for the recovery yoga you missed and shortened Saturday to a 75 min indoor Z2 ride because of the thunderstorms. Sunday's Workout B stays with no load increase, so you still get one heavy lift this week, with a lighter option if you still feel flat.

days.details:
Warmup: 200 m easy freestyle, mixing in backstroke every 4th length
Main set: 6x100 m freestyle at easy aerobic effort (RPE 4-5), 20 s rest; then 4x25 m catch-up drill, 15 s rest
Cooldown: 100 m easy choice stroke
Total: 1000 m
Objective: Low-stress aerobic movement to start the week fresh for Tuesday's committed double.

days.session: Committed double: controlled AM hills ride + PM hard MTB group ride
days.details:
150 min total (60 AM + ~90 PM) | Controlled climbing volume AM, group intensity PM | AM: Z2 with climbs capped at low Z3 / RPE 6; PM: RPE 8-9 on chosen efforts
AM Hills road ride (60 min): 15 min Z1-2 warm-up, then rolling hills; climb seated at Z2 to low Z3 (RPE 6 max), no attacks or all-out efforts, 10 min Z1 spin home. Wet alternative: 50 min indoor Z2 with 4x4 min low Z3 at 80-85 rpm, 3 min easy between.
Lunch: no gym, eat a carb-rich lunch.
PM Hard MTB group ride (~90 min): pick 2-3 climbs or segments to ride hard, recover fully in between, ride the rest at conversational pace.
Fuelling: 1 bottle with 30-60 g carbs for the PM ride, plus a carb and protein meal within 60 min after.
days.fallback: AM: cut to 40 min flat Z1-2 or skip it. PM (non-negotiable): ride with the group but sit in, let surges go and cap effort at RPE 7.

days.details: 40 min restorative/yin flow: hips, hamstrings, glutes, thoracic spine and neck, finishing with 5 min of slow nasal breathing. Optional 20-30 min easy walk at lunch.

days.session: AM threshold intervals (indoor) + lunch Workout A
days.details:
50 min | Threshold to build aerobic-high capacity | Z4 low, 90-95% FTP, RPE 7
Warm-up: 12 min Z1-2 building, including 2x1 min Z3
Main set: 3x8 min Z4 low (90-95% FTP, 85-95 rpm), 4 min Z1-2 recovery between
Cool-down: 6 min Z1

Lunch (4+ h after the ride), 45 min:
Workout A:
Warm-up: 5 min easy row, leg swings, glute bridges 2x10, 2 ramp sets of goblet squat
Back Squat 3x6 (~70-75% of previous working load, 3 RIR)
Romanian Deadlift 3x8 (3 RIR)
Single-arm Dumbbell Row 3x8/side
Pallof Press 3x10/side
Side Plank 2x30s/side
Rest: 2-3 min between squat and RDL sets, 60-90 s on accessories
Objective: Reintroduce heavy lower-body loading after ~4 weeks out of the gym without causing soreness that carries into Saturday's long ride.
days.fallback: Ride 50 min steady Z2 with no intervals. Gym: do Pallof Press, Side Plank and the row only, plus 15 min mobility, and skip squats and RDLs.

days.details:
40 min restorative/yin flow: hips, hamstrings, glutes, thoracic spine and neck, finishing with 5 min of slow nasal breathing. This replaces Wednesday's missed recovery session and gives the legs a full day off the bike after three MTB days this week.
Optional: 20-30 min easy walk at lunch if the drizzle holds off.

75 min | Aerobic base, easy volume for the Garmin aerobic-low gap | Z2, RPE 3-4, talk-test pace
Indoor on Zwift or trainer because of the thunderstorms. Warm up 10 min Z1 building to Z2, ride 60 min steady Z2 at 85-95 rpm, cool down 5 min Z1.
No intervals or surges. If HR drifts above Z2, ease off rather than push.
Fuelling: 1 bottle with ~30-40 g carbs; indoor rides run hot, so drink 500-750 ml/h.

Workout B:
Warm-up: 5 min easy bike, hip airplanes 2x5/side, glute bridges 2x10, 2 ramp sets of leg press
Leg Press 3x6 (~70-75% of previous working load, 3 RIR, no increase this week)
Hip Thrust 3x8 (3 RIR)
Dumbbell Bench Press 3x8 (2-3 RIR)
Dead Bug 3x8/side
Copenhagen Plank 2x20s/side
Rest: 2-3 min on leg press and hip thrust, 60-90 s on the rest
Objective: Keep one heavy lower-body stimulus this week without progressing load, finishing ~44 h before Tuesday's controlled AM ride and ~52 h before the PM group ride.
days.fallback: Swap for 40 min yoga or mobility plus Dead Bug and Copenhagen Plank only, and skip the heavy lower-body lifts.
